about: Perfect Universe is a collection of games that play with gravity, resulting in awesome crazy physics. It features nine game modes, single and local multi-player options, a beautiful monochrome art style and highly detailed environments.
Perfect Moon - classic platforming as you control a man collecting gems
Moon Life - control an alien in this QWOP-like game
Star Light - fly your rocket ship through the galaxy in a Thrust-like game
Moon Golf – an interplanetary game of golf
Gravity Dodge – a four player game of gravity-defying dodge ball
Balloon Pop – scramble to pop more balloons than anyone else!
Rocket Ball – football but with rockets!
Moon Volley – a game of volleyball
Space Race – rocket race against friends
summary: Perfect Universe is a collection of games that play with gravity, resulting in awesome crazy physics.
